subject: Help diagnosing/fixing error "c++ exception (unknown reason)" during sampling

messages.author: 326b797bbe8d994a
messages.subject: Help diagnosing/fixing error "c++ exception (unknown reason)" during sampling
parts:
In writing an example for section 6.2 of Gelman & Hill (2006) (p. 112), I receive the following error in my example model, which compiles fine:

SAMPLING FOR MODEL 'stops_eth' NOW (CHAIN 1).
[1] "Error in sampler$call_sampler(args_list[[i]]) : "
[2] "  c++ exception (unknown reason)"                
error occurred during calling the sampler; sampling not done

I'm running rstan 2.15.1 within R 3.4.0.

I'm using R to call the Stan program: 
library(rstan)

source("frisks.data.R")

dataList <- c("N","stops","arrests")
stops_eth_poisson.sf1 <- stan(file='stops_eth.stan', data=dataList,
                         iter=1000, chains=4)



I've attached the data file, and the Stan program "stops_eth.stan" follows:

data {
  int<lower=1> N;
  int<lower=0> stops[N];
  vector<lower=0>[N] arrests;
}
transformed data {
  vector[N] log_arrests;
  log_arrests = log(arrests);
}
parameters {
  vector[2] beta;
}
model {
  target += poisson_lpmf(stops | beta[1] + beta[2] * log_arrests);
}

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: Help diagnosing/fixing error "c++ exception (unknown reason)" during sampling
parts:
On Saturday, May 6, 2017 at 1:12:05 PM UTC-4, sas...@columbia.edu wrote:
data {
  int<lower=1> N;
  int<lower=0> stops[N];
  vector<lower=0>[N] arrests;
}
transformed data {
  vector[N] log_arrests;
  log_arrests = log(arrests);
}
parameters {
  vector[2] beta;
}
model {
  target += poisson_lpmf(stops | beta[1] + beta[2] * log_arrests);
}

You want poisson_log_lpmf(stops | beta[1] + beta[2] * log_arrests). Also, doing log(arrests) is problematic when some observations on arrests are 0.

Ben
